Interaction targeting, range and modal cleanup

One player-owned interaction component resolves an interactable actor and asks the server to perform a specific action. NPCs, loot, nodes, banks and gates implement a narrow interaction interface without owning the player's inventory.

Scope and player interaction

One player-owned interaction component resolves an interactable actor and asks the server to perform a specific action. NPCs, loot, nodes, banks and gates implement a narrow interaction interface without owning the player's inventory.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase03committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

NoTarget → Candidate → RequestPending → InteractionOpen → OutOfRange → Closed

WBP_Notifications observes results from URPGInteractionComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Interaction_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
TargetActorId: current replicated actor reference plus persistent source ID when applicable
InteractionVerb: allowlisted action tag such as Interact.Talk or Interact.Gather
InteractionRangeCm=250; per-definition override with server limit
InteractionNonce: server-issued short-lived context bound to character, target and zone epoch
EligibilityRevision: optional NPC/offer/node generation revision
RequiresLineOfSight=true except deliberately authored nonphysical UI actions

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGInteractionComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_NotificationsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
FindLocalCandidate(ViewContext) -> Candidate|None; cosmetic hint only
ServerRequestInteraction(CommandId, TargetActor, Verb) -> Opened|OutOfRange|NoLineOfSight|WrongState
CloseInteraction(Nonce, Reason) -> Closed; server/local cleanup
ValidateInteractionContext(Nonce, CharacterSession) -> Valid|Expired|WrongZone; server custom helper

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Local overlap/trace selects a hint by distance/priority; display the intended verb and target name without asserting eligibility.
  2. Client sends the actor reference and verb via its owned PlayerController or component RPC; never issue a Server RPC on an unowned resource actor.
  3. Server resolves that actor in its own world, checks alive/session/readiness, capsule-to-target distance, LOS and supported interface/verb.
  4. Domain owner returns an interaction context, such as a vendor quote or fishing action ID; it alone validates later state-changing commands.
  5. UMG opens the corresponding screen using the context nonce. A later sale/craft/turn-in repeats range/session checks and does not rely on the initial conversation forever.
  6. Leaving range, death, travel or actor destruction closes the context and cancels reversible actions. An already committed economic result is reconciled by receipt rather than undone by UI closure.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Define IRPGInteractable as a native UInterface with query/context and server-dispatch responsibilities. Expose the presentation query to Blueprint but keep authority checks native.
  2. Add URPGInteractionComponent once to BP_PlayerCharacter. Route IA_Interact Started through BP_RPGPlayerController to the owned component.
  3. Place InteractProbe in L_NetworkLab with an explicit collision/query volume and stable probe ID. Add a wall between it and one PlayerStart for LOS rejection.
  4. Configure the interaction collision channel under Project Settings > Collision and document responses; sprite layers remain NoCollision.
  5. Bind WBP_Notifications to structured rejection events; reopen gate/NPC/resource child Blueprints in their phases to implement the allowed verb and domain reference.

Reopen Phase03 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / InteractProbe / GateProbe. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Forged target from another zone -> InvalidTarget, no backend command.
Target destroyed between hint and request -> TargetGone; close hint safely.
Player sends NPC purchase while 1 km away -> OutOfRange even if UI remains open.
Late close after committed buy -> UI closes, owned item remains; no client-driven refund.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

250 cm is an initial range for a full-height avatar; tune to actual environment scale. Rate limit interaction starts independently from UI hover traces.

Record target persistent ID, verb, session epoch and reason; no per-frame hover logs. Controller focus and screen-reader label should identify the same candidate as the visible prompt.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
